passes.name: counts
passes.purpose: Deterministic counts (React commits, rendered and mounted fibers, layouts, the scenario's own) confirm the mechanism. Instrumented: no timing claims.

passes.name: pilot
passes.purpose: One short trial: both sides run, the per-iteration time feeds the ETA, a first look at the spread. Give it a smaller workload through the scenario's size knob if it has one ("cfg": { … }).

passes.name: main
passes.purpose: The timing verdict: 4 v 4 sessions at 4x and 1x.

passes.name: ctl
passes.purpose: Paired control: 0 / 10 ms injected per unit of work inside each session must land (k 8, warm-up 2: 3 pairs a session).

passes.name: more
passes.purpose: One more ABBA block of main (sessions main-5-A …). Runs only with --only=more, when aggregate's advice says more sessions could change a verdict.
